_comment: Lean profile for af <project> <model> local-model mode (CFG-506). NO hooks by design: the fleet SessionStart chain costs more context than a local model has. Do not add hooks here without re-measuring the startup token cost. The statusLine is NOT a hook — it costs zero context and is the only readout of how much of a 16k-256k window is left, which matters more here than on cloud Opus.
